columns.name: GUIDE_ID
columns.description: Guide Id for which assignment is created

columns.name: GUIDE_TYPE
columns.description: Represents the type of guide Id

columns.name: GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: User friendly uniquely identifying number for assignment

columns.name: GUIDE_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Guide assignment (e.g Active,InActive,Errored etc.)

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGED_DATE
columns.description: Date to be captured during status change. For example during Withdrawal or Completion.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_COMMENT
columns.description: Comments to be captured during status change. For example during Withdrawal or Completion.

columns.name: STATUS_CHANGE_TYPE
columns.description: To capture the change in status like Withdrawal or Completion.

columns.name: ASSIGNED_ON_DATE
columns.description: The date that the assignment is assigned to the Guide user.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person Id for which Guide assignment record

columns.name: WORK_ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Person work assignment id  for which Guide assignment record is.

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason for assignment status change. Example: useful when errored (if Person work assignment is part of multiple) Guide assignment created

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
